Neither density, finite support, mean-one labor, utility smoothness, consumption positivity nor strict impatience is required for this unconditional clause.

[dep:S05; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M10B2/CapsAboveNatural.lean] Stationary conclusions additionally retain positive-consumption C1 smoothness with positive marginal utility, C2 smoothness with eventual upper relative-risk-aversion control, distinct labor endpoints with positive mass in every endpoint neighborhood, and beta*(1+r)<1. The two strict-impatience witnesses concern identical households and impose the same restriction. S05 supplies compact support, invariance and uniqueness among all resource probability laws. E02 proves finite stationary net-asset expectations directly from compact support and continuous policy, without A02.

contract_assessments.assessment: [contract:E02; context:gate; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M10B2/CapsAboveNatural.lean; ledger:E02] The exported theorem covers arbitrary finite nonnegative caps weakly above the natural limit at fixed w>0 and r>0, including equality. The positive-rate minimum formula proves identical shifts and normalized primitives; congruence yields exact canonical value, asset-policy, consumption-policy, kernel and law-step equality under BASIC alone. The stationary clause separately retains S05 smoothness, curvature, endpoint nondegeneracy and strict impatience. Invariance and full-space uniqueness identify the selected laws. Compact support and policy continuity establish integrability of A(z)-phi before interpreting supply as a finite expectation. The argument requires neither E01 nor A02 and introduces no marginal-boundary substitution or convergence-of-moments inference. A94 equation (2b) and footnote 29 support the economics; the weak-boundary case and formal transports are correctly identified as reconstructions. Exact signatures, all 15 export audits, permitted axioms, preservation evidence and REVIEW_READY ledger/status agree.

dimension_assessments.summary: The export covers every finite nonnegative cap pair weakly above the natural limit at w,r>0, including equality; exact primitive/policy equality precedes the separately conditional stationary and net-supply clause.

min_eq_right proves both shifts equal the natural limit. Equal normalized records give canonical-object equality by congruence. Transported invariance and S05 uniqueness identify the laws; compact-support integrability and identical policy, shift and measure give finite supply equality.

Normalization sets R=1+r and intercept=-r*phi. Resources z determine shifted saving A(z); fresh next-period labor generates R*A(z)+e(l). Net supply integrates A(z)-phi, preserving the distinction between resources, shifted saving and original assets.

Visually inspected A94 extraction pp.1–3: printed 666,672,673/original PDF 9,15,16. Equation (2b) gives min(b,natural); footnote 29 gives cap irrelevance above natural. Boundary equality and formal transports are reconstructions. A93 has no invented extension locator.

BASIC and positive-rate finite-cap premises suffice for policies. Only stationarity adds positive-state smoothness, eventual curvature control, nondegenerate essential endpoints and beta*R<1, matching S05.

No equality, optimizer or invariant-law existence is assumed. Cap inequalities feed the minimum formula; S05 constructs the law. The duplicated impatience witnesses express the same feasible condition for identical households.

The helper uses P02/H02/H04/S05 without E01 or A02. The wrapper adds its authorized import and theorem. Controller fingerprints preserve the accepted E01 declaration and certify the unchanged accepted source prefix.

Resources remain all NNReal and labor uses an arbitrary compact-interval probability law with fresh iid draws. No grid, density or finite-support restriction appears; endpoint nondegeneracy is confined to stationarity.

The new proof uses no marginal object, including at zero effective income. H04 supplies continuous policy on all NNReal. Nothing interprets rightMarginalValue m 0 as a boundary marginal; the separate potentially infinite zeroRightMarginal convention remains intact.

S05 gives probability-one compact support. Continuous real-valued asset policy is integrable on that compact set, and restriction equals the full measure. Subtracting finite phi preserves integrability. These facts accompany supply equality; no ENNReal.toReal conversion is used.

Law equality follows from invariance and uniqueness, not from a convergence argument. Stationary first moments are justified by compact support. S05's weak convergence is neither strengthened to total variation nor used to infer moment convergence.

Strict impatience and S05 regularity occur only inside the final stationary implication. Primitive, value, policy, kernel and law-step equalities require no consumption positivity or hidden subcriticality.

Inspected proof bodies use ordinary equality transport, accepted theorems and integration lemmas. No sorry, admit, project axiom, native_decide or unsafe bypass appears; controller no-sorry and prohibited-pattern checks pass.

All 15 new-export axiom records contain only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The controller reports the same permitted union across 731 audited declarations; both audit files cover every new export.

The 15 exports match the exact signature and axiom inventories. Every export has #check, assert_no_sorry and #print axioms in both audit files. The public signature retains the weak inequalities and separate stationary quantifiers.

Ledger and global overview consistently mark E02 REVIEW_READY and E03 UNFORMALIZED. The ledger matches the branch-specific assumptions, equality proof and integrability argument; TeX/PDF synchronization is controller-verified.

capHousehold rebuilds actual normalized prices from P02's finite-cap formula while preserving preferences and the income law. Equalities concern accepted Bellman value and optimal policies, the actual transition, and an invariant law selected from S05. Net supply is finite expected original saving A-phi.

Weak cap inequalities, unrestricted-state policy equality and exact law equality are retained. Stationarity assumptions are explicit and authorized. No finite-state, moment-convergence or different probability interpretation is substituted.

New helpers only construct cap households, select S05 objects, prove their integrability and establish E02 equality. No government-debt correspondence, cap monotonicity, equilibrium, money or growth theorem is introduced.

The inspected proof meets E02, source correspondence is verified, and audits and status evidence agree. No mathematical or evidentiary blocker remains within the accepted-interface scope; operative GREEN remains the controller's decision.
